name: roblox-developer-tools
title: Roblox Developer Tools
description: Manage your Roblox development workflow from Raycast
author: zw1ce

commands.name: robux-earned
commands.title: Robux Earned
commands.subtitle: Roblox
commands.description: Show game or account earnings in the menu bar in Robux or estimated DevEx USD

preferences.name: earningsSource
preferences.title: Earnings Source
preferences.description: Choose earnings from a game or your Roblox account

preferences.name: earningsPeriod
preferences.title: Time Range
preferences.description: All-time includes all history available from Roblox; game analytics retain up to four years

preferences.name: earningsDisplay
preferences.title: Display Amount As
preferences.description: USD is an estimate at the standard DevEx rate of $0.0038 per Robux, before fees and eligibility checks

preferences.name: earningsUserId
preferences.title: Roblox User ID
preferences.description: The number in your Roblox profile URL; required only for Roblox Account earnings source

preferences.name: robloxSecurityCookie
preferences.title: Roblox Session Cookie
preferences.description: Your .ROBLOSECURITY login cookie; required only for Roblox Account earnings source

preferences.name: hideZeroEarnings
preferences.label: Hide when zero
preferences.description: Keep refreshing while hidden and show the item when earnings change

commands.name: player-count
commands.title: Player Count
commands.subtitle: Roblox
commands.description: Display your universe's player count in the menu bar

preferences.name: hideZeroPlayers
preferences.label: Hide when zero
preferences.description: Hide only when enabled and the player count is zero

commands.name: publish
commands.title: Publish Place
commands.subtitle: Roblox
commands.description: Publish the current place in Studio

preferences.name: closeAllVersions
preferences.label: Restart all versions
preferences.description: Turn off to restart outdated servers only

commands.name: game-page
commands.title: Open Game Page
commands.subtitle: Roblox
commands.description: Open your universe's public Roblox game page

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Open in Creator Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Roblox
commands.description: Open your universe's Overview page in Creator Dashboard

preferences.name: universeId
preferences.title: Universe ID
preferences.description: Required for Player Count, Open in Studio, Open Game Page, Open in Creator Dashboard, Restart Servers, and Robux Earned (Game)

preferences.name: placeId
preferences.title: Place ID
preferences.description: Required for Launch Game and Open in Studio

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Required for Restart Servers [universe:write] and Robux Earned (Game) [universe.analytics:read]
